# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Currently, CameoDB only provides security updates for the latest major version.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| v0.x    | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Security is a top priority for the CameoDB team. If you discover a vulnerability, we would like to know about it so we can take steps to address it as quickly as possible.

Please **DO NOT** report security vulnerabilities via public GitHub issues.

Instead, please report them to us via email at: **goran.cvijanovic@gmail.com** (or another preferred email if you update this file).

### What to include in your report
- A description of the vulnerability and its impact
- Steps to reproduce the vulnerability (e.g. payload, configuration, or sequence of events)
- Any potential workarounds or mitigation strategies you know of

### Our Response Process
We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within 48 hours and strive to send you regular updates about our progress. If the issue is verified as a security vulnerability, we will work to patch it and release an update in a timely manner. We will also publish a security advisory giving you credit for the discovery (unless you prefer to remain anonymous).
